issues.description: Silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED breaks existing callers without reasoned migration path.
issues.detail: The default of `turn_detection_mode` flips from EXTERNAL to FIXED. No precondition is stated for which callers may rely on the prior default. Anyone who omitted the parameter now gets different endpointing semantics. UNREASONED: the author cannot, from this diff, demonstrate that the postcondition (caller behavior) is preserved.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED added to a set test without evidence it exists in the dependency.
issues.detail: `self._enable_vad` now tests membership against `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED`. If the imported `speechmatics.voice_agent` package does not define that enum value, this raises AttributeError at construction. The invariant `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is defined` is asserted without proof in the diff. TESTED-NOT-PROVED at best.

issues.description: Frame-handling branch leaves a smuggled goto: the warning-then-fallthrough flow is unstructured.
issues.detail: In `process_frame`, when `_enable_vad` is true the branch logs a warning and silently does nothing; the `elif not self._enable_vad` is logically `else`. The control flow encodes a state machine via flags rather than a stated invariant. SMUGGLED-GOTO under a polite name. State the precondition on `_client` and the postcondition on finalization explicitly.

issues.description: `speech_segment_config` is unconditionally overwritten, discarding any value set by the generic loop.
issues.detail: The preceding loop may iterate keys including future segment-related fields, then the code overwrites `config.speech_segment_config` wholesale. The frame (what may change vs. not) is not stated. If `SpeechSegmentConfig` later grows fields, callers will silently lose them. Construct once with all known fields, or document the frame.

issues.description: Comment-shuffle in `_handle_start_of_turn` is noise; if the metrics call is dead, delete it.
issues.detail: Moving a commented-out `await self.start_processing_metrics()` from after to before two awaits changes nothing executable and signals indecision. Either the metrics call is part of the specification or it is not. Decide. Commented code is folklore, not reasoning.

issues.description: `split_sentences` default coerced via `or False` masks the tri-state semantics of `bool | None`.
issues.detail: `params.split_sentences` is declared `bool | None = None` but written as `params.split_sentences or False`. This collapses None and False, defeating the point of an optional. State the precondition: is None 'use library default' or 'disabled'? Pick one and encode it; do not paper over with `or`.

review.summary: The diff changes a public default (EXTERNAL to FIXED) and rewires VAD-related control flow without stating the preconditions, postconditions, or invariants the change must preserve. Two changes depend on an external library symbol (`EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED`, `SpeechSegmentConfig`) whose existence is asserted by import rather than proved in this PR. The frame-handling branch encodes a state machine via flags and an elif-pretending-to-be-else; this is structured programming only in costume. None of these defects are necessarily wrong in operation — they are unreasoned. The author should state, per public method, what must hold on entry and on exit, and demonstrate that the new defaults preserve postconditions for existing callers.
